claims.text: The driver's own trace measures this trip at 14.44 km against a platform optimal of 12.00 km — an excess of 2.44 km, or 20.33% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment gates are passed: the excess is greater than 0.80 km in absolute terms AND greater than 20% of optimal_distance_km. The governing figure is gps_trace.trace_distance_km (14.44), not the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km (14.4), which POL-RD-01 expressly forbids citing for the threshold test.

The excess rests on an unimpaired trace and needs no independent corroboration. The trace carries 114 fixes at a 10 s sampling interval with 100.0% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0 s, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met: there is no gap over 90 s, no straight-line jump over 500 m and no sustained interval above 30 s. POL-RD-07(ii) therefore does not bite, and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-02818 and the same pickup and trip timestamps, and the excess is measured from an unimpaired trace. The rider also does not attract the extra corroboration requirement of POL-RD-08: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0, far below the 4-claim trigger, so no second source beyond the trace is required.

The driver's explanation — 'Minor detour because of a road works sign' — cannot be tested and cannot exonerate him. The bundle's only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02818-01, is MISSING: its weight_multiplier is 0.0 and its issue code is MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I disclose that impairment expressly. With no advisory on file naming a road or segment the optimal route traverses, and no validity window, POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cites no evidence ID for an advisory, POL-RD-13(1) governs: this is a gap in the bundle, not the invocation of an exculpatory clause against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-10(5) does not fire and the case does not escalate.

No rider instruction explains the excess. The chat log for this trip carries 0 messages (message_count 0, first and last message timestamps null), so there is no POL-RD-04(a) instruction from the rider, no compliant timestamp, and no chat_message.waypoint_hint against which the 200 m corroboration test could be run. POL-RD-04 is unavailable and no distance may be excluded from the excess on that ground.

No relocation of the pickup or dropoff occurred: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null and amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are both null, so POL-RD-05 has no amended endpoints and no stored re-quote to apply. The deviation stands measured against the booked optimal of 12.0 km. POL-RD-10(5) is likewise not triggered, because that limb presupposes an amendment timestamp with a missing re-quote, and here there is no amendment at all.

On the POL-RD-02 arithmetic the rider is owed a refund. fare_model on the fare_breakdown is METERED, so POL-RD-02 governs and POL-RD-11 does not apply. Stated on the separate lines the clause requires: charged_total = SGD 20.66; recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 12.0 + 0.28 x 16.0) x 1.00 surge) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP = SGD 18.08; refund = 20.66 - 18.08 = SGD 2.58, rounded up to SGD 2.60 payable. That refund is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor, so the outcome is not NO_ACTION, and it is 12.5% of charged_total, below the 90% share, so the correct outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 2.60 and not a full refund. The surge multiplier was read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier (1.0).

No separate pass-through correction is due, and nothing may be netted against the distance refund: the fare_breakdown carries no ERP gantry, no toll and no airport surcharge (erp_lines total SGD 0.00; airport_surcharge 0.00), and this trip does not originate at an airport. Every charged line — base fare 3.80, distance charge, time charge and the 0.80 platform fee — has a counterpart in the metered rate card and the trip record, so POL-RD-10(8) is not engaged and there is no unmatched line requiring escalation.

I do not press for a POL-RD-06 uplift and the record does not support one: this deviation is not MATERIAL (20.33% is below the 50% gate and 2.44 km is below the 8.0 km gate), and the driver_profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 1 over completed_trips_90d of 188 — below both the 3-flag threshold and the 0.05 ratio threshold. No repeat pattern is established, so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral follows, and no driver compensation arises either, the billed 14.4 km falling only 0.04 km short of the trace and far below the 1.0 km shortfall gate.

The present state of this payment is a full charge in place: fare_breakdown.payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00. NO_ACTION is party-relative and would leave the rider carrying the entire SGD 20.66 for a trip the trace shows ran 2.44 km and 20.33% over the optimal route. Only the POL-RD-02 refund, SGD 2.60, leaves the rider not carrying the charge attributable to the deviation.
